payload.text: (2026-09-23, hv first-hand in prose, answering vc's question on ic's F3; wording vc's) EVERYTHING FOUND GOES INTO 3.2.1. hv, verbatim: "Yes, it's all got to go into 3.2.1. All of it." So F3, filed as 0532, is in the cut and dc builds it. Board views indent a multi-line item's continuation lines, and doctor reads the old shape as an uncounted StaleRender, so no estate's commits are refused while its boards wait for a re-render. It joins 0525, 0529, 0530 and 0531. VC READS "ALL OF IT" TO TAKE IN molt-vc's TWO ITEMS AS WELL. vc had carried them as post-3.2.1 backlog on its own classification and never on hv's: 0533 (ic: a supported query for where the gate's install root resolves) and 0534 (cc: `intent --version` says whether it is a release or a dev build). A finding made before the cut is fixed before the cut. WHAT THE RULING DOES NOT REACH, on vc's reading: ST0060 and ST0077, which hv put on hold by name on 2026-09-23 and did not lift.
